methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, pointing toward distributed peer-to-peer learning networks that could democratize AI fluency across underserved regions.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA indicates institutional investment in broad-based AI education and community impact beyond elite research labs, creating infrastructure for distributed deep learning that extends beyond the capital's business district.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Commentary explicitly naming AI data centers as drivers of urban-rural divide confirms that concentrated infrastructure investment in NoVA is exacerbating rather than bridging regional capability gaps, with capital flowing to already-advantaged areas.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: AI use strong in Virginia, with Montgomery County at No. 5 statewide - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Montgomery County ranking #5 statewide in AI usage reveals deep capability concentration around Virginia Tech's research ecosystem, creating a secondary excellence pocket but also highlighting how AI adoption remains clustered around academic anchor institutions.

signals.title: Virginia Tech, Children’s National Spark Pediatric AI Innovation Hub to Speed Research, Care | Newswise - Newswise
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's pediatric AI hub partnership concentrates specialized research capability in Blacksburg while partnering with DC-area Children's National, reinforcing the metro research triangle pattern rather than distributing expertise to rural healthcare systems.
